name: cache-keepwarm
description: Keeps the prompt cache of an idle Claude Code session warm: just before the cache lapses it submits a short service prompt, so your next message reads the context from the cache instead of writing it again. Off by default; /keepwarm on|off|status. Needs function hooks (early access).

enabled.title: Keep the cache warm
enabled.description: Ping before the cache lapses while the session is idle; /keepwarm on|off overrides this and is remembered

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: 1h on a Claude subscription, 5m on an API key, cloud provider or usage credits

leadSeconds.title: Ping before expiry (s)
leadSeconds.description: How long before the cache lapses the ping is sent (at most half the lifetime)

maxPings.title: Pings in a row
maxPings.description: Most pings without a prompt of your own; then the cache is left to lapse

minTokens.title: Smallest cache kept (tokens)
minTokens.description: Caches smaller than this are cheap to rebuild and are not pinged

message.title: Ping text
message.description: The service prompt the model receives; empty uses the built-in one
